items.description: Canonical action vocabulary. MUST be of the form ak.<segment>.<segment>... matching capabilities.md §5. Bare names without the ak. prefix are not permitted; consult capabilities.md before introducing new action names. Wildcards within a segment are not permitted in this schema; the resource selector controls scope, not action expansion.

capability_action_registry_digest.description: JCS SHA-256 digest of the complete canonical capability-action-registry.json snapshot used to expand aggregate_admin actions. Required by the reducer whenever actions[] contains an action whose registry row has event_mapping_kind=aggregate_admin; optional and audit-only otherwise. Unknown or unavailable snapshots fail closed with capability_registry_basis_unavailable.

constraints.description: Constraints applied to this grant. Delegation control MUST be expressed via constraint_type='delegation_control' and max_delegation_depth (see capabilities.md §10). Top-level delegable is forbidden and MUST be rejected as schema_violation. With no delegation_control constraint the grant is not delegable (equivalent to max_delegation_depth=0).

issued_at.description: Grant issuance time — carries the 'creation time' semantics for a Capability Grant in place of the generic created_at (models/common-fields.md §3.2). Retention / audit / ordering queries MUST use issued_at / expires_at / revoked_at rather than falling back to created_at.

not_before.description: Top-level grant validity start. Authorization evaluates this together with temporal constraints: effective_not_before = max(not_before, every temporal.not_before present).

expires_at.description: Top-level grant validity end. Authorization evaluates this together with temporal constraints: effective_expires_at = min(expires_at, every temporal.expires_at present). Delegated grants MUST not extend beyond the parent's effective_expires_at.

updated_by.description: Reducer-derived actor that produced the most recent grant lifecycle update. Ordinary grant body fields remain immutable; revocation still uses revoked_by/revoked_at.

updated_at.description: Reducer-derived timestamp for the most recent grant lifecycle update. Ordinary grant body fields remain immutable; revocation still uses revoked_by/revoked_at.

proofs.description: Detached grant proofs sign canonical_json({context:'ak.capability-grant-proof-v1', payload_digest, issuer, subject, verification_method, created_at, domain?, audience?}); context is a fixed signing-context domain tag, not a wire field. payload_digest is the canonical hash of the grant body with proofs removed.

allOf.$comment: Lint condition (2) from capabilities.md §18.1: grants whose actions[] include moderator-role actions MUST carry a constraint with depends_on_moderation_state=true. Conditions (1) and (3) (subject condition selector referencing moderation state, constraints referencing moderation queue/cell) are reducer-side lint and not enforced here.
